record.question: Which of the following is not an assumption in Euler's beam theory?
options: Column is initially straight and loaded axially.
Beam material is homogeneous, isotropic and elastic.
Plane section before bending remains plane after bending.
Beam axis bends but does not stretch.
record.explanation: Euler beam theory assumes transverse bending of a homogeneous, isotropic, elastic beam with plane sections remaining plane and no axial stretching of the axis. A column that is loaded axially belongs to Euler column theory rather than beam bending theory, so this is the non-assumption.
